name: Green Visa (5-year self-sponsored residence)

requirements.blocker_text: This requires a UAE employment contract, MoHRE occupational level 1, 2, or 3, a bachelor's degree or equivalent, and a salary of at least AED 15,000/month.
requirements.fix_path: Negotiate a salary meeting the threshold, or confirm occupational level classification.

requirements.blocker_text: This requires an MoHRE freelance/self-employment permit, a bachelor's degree or specialised diploma, and self-employment income of at least AED 360,000 over the previous 2 years (or proof of financial solvency).
requirements.fix_path: Build the required income history or demonstrate financial solvency.

requirements.blocker_text: This requires shares or investment in a UAE commercial project, approved by the competent local authorities.

evidence_required.document: Employment contract, freelance permit, or investment evidence matching the applicable group

sources.title: Green Visa - The Official Portal of the UAE Government / Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratisation

notes: Self-sponsored — confirmed, no employer or national sponsor required, a genuine structural advantage over ae_standard_employment_visa. Family sponsorship rights are broader than the standard employment visa: Green Visa holders may sponsor first-degree relatives, still subject to the same standard sponsorship income rules (AED 4,000/month, or AED 3,000 + accommodation) seen on ae_family_sponsorship. Six-month grace period after expiry/cancellation — genuinely more generous than most work-tied visas in this dataset, which typically leave the holder with 30 days or less. Same structural ceiling as every UAE route: leads_to_pr and leads_to_citizenship are FALSE — renewable indefinitely, no settlement pipeline.
